title: Packers WR Matthew Golden: I wouldn't change anything about my rookie season

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Packers WR Matthew Golden: I wouldn't change anything about my rookie season
sources.description: The Packers broke with tradition by taking wide receiver Matthew Golden in the first round of the 2025 draft, but he didn't make an immediate jump to the top of the depth chart during his rookie season.
